svg.aria-label: Architecture of the FlexCache performance lab: an operator machine runs Terraform against AWS; the origin VPC holds FSx for ONTAP Origin and an EC2 client, the cache VPC holds FSx for ONTAP Cache with the FlexCache volume and an EC2 client; the VPCs are peered and FlexCache reads flow between the file systems over the intercluster ports 11104-11105.
svg.title: FlexCache performance lab architecture
svg.text: FlexCache performance lab on FSx for NetApp ONTAP
Four Terraform stacks, run in order from one machine · no NAT, internet gateway or public IPs in the VPCs
your Mac or the test machine
AWS region eu-west-1 (default: origin_region = cache_region; different regions also work)
VPC · FSx · EC2 · IAM · Secrets Manager
fills on first read, then serves locally
Clients log in through the EC2 Instance Connect or SSM endpoints. Destroy in reverse order: 04 → 03 → 02 → 01.
